emulator.name: Azahar
emulator._source: world source: albw/Citra.py connects to 127.0.0.1:45987, Citra's scripting protocol. Azahar is the living Citra fork and the backend London offers.

client.name: A Link Between Worlds Client
client._kind_source: London 3.13.0: the launcher itself is the client -- LaunchViaAzaharAsync connects to Azahar's scripting server (UDP 45987, the protocol measured from the world's Citra.py) and runs Plugins/Scripts/games/albw.lua in Snes9xLuaBridge passthrough mode. The world's own Component is no longer started; the address map and watcher logic were ported from albw/Client.py (GPL-2.0).

apworld._source: the author's own releases page; the newest asset is albw.apworld (tag v0.3.2)

_patch_note: The seed lives in a layered-FS mod, not in the ROM: the zip's 00040000000EC300/ goes into the emulator's load/mods, owned by whichever seed launched last (cleared and rewritten on seed change), and the ROM launched is a per-(slot, seed) copy so the emulated SD card -- where 3DS saves actually live -- follows the seed too.

credits._note: The game is the property of its publisher and is never distributed here; the player supplies their own copy. Only the plugin itself is by solida1987.

patch._source: world source: albw/Patch.py -- ALBWProcedurePatch's procedure is [("patch_albw", ["patch_info.json"])], a step name only the world's own ALBWPatchExtension implements, and result_file_ending is .zip. London never runs world Python; the player opens the .apalbw with Archipelago's own client (the world's setup guide's own flow), which builds a zip holding the 3DS mod folder 00040000000EC300/. London stores THAT zip per (seed, slot), installs it into Azahar's load/mods before every launch, and plays a per-seed copy of the player's own dump.

_patch_extension_source: albw/Patch.py declares ALBWPatchExtension with the new step name patch_albw. Refused as a patch STEP per the catalogue's rule -- but the seed still arrives, as the finished zip the world's own client builds.
_lua_module_source: albw.lua is generated from the world's own Locations.py and native albwrandomizer library (453 locations, 367 with codes, 77 item ids), not typed by hand.
_checks_verified_source: Live-proven 25 Aug 2026 against a real seed server, through the in-launcher bridge: item IN (Progressive Sword delivered into the running game, item-get shown) and check OUT (Ravio's Shop (5) purchase sent Song of Awakening to another slot).
